searchDocs.title: PredicateFn​
searchDocs.content: </> type PredicateFn = (module: ModuleScript ) → boolean Decides whether a ModuleScript should be loaded.

searchDocs.title: ModuleFunction​
searchDocs.content: </> type ModuleFunction = (...any) → ...any A module method, or a module that returns a function.

searchDocs.title: ModuleDict​
searchDocs.content: </> type ModuleDict = {[string]: any} A module that returns a table. Methods named after a phase are called with the table as self, and an optional Priority number controls start order (higher first, default 0).

searchDocs.title: ModuleDef​
searchDocs.content: </> type ModuleDef = ModuleFunction | ModuleDict Whatever a loaded ModuleScript returned.

searchDocs.title: LoadedModules​
searchDocs.content: </> type LoadedModules = {[string]: ModuleDef} Loaded modules keyed by Instance:GetFullName(). Two sets can be merged with a + b, which returns a new table and warns about duplicate names.

searchDocs.title: LoadDescendants​
searchDocs.content: </> OnBoot.LoadDescendants( root: Instance | {Instance }, predicate: PredicateFn? ) → LoadedModules Requires every ModuleScript descendant of root. Modules that fail to load are warned about with a traceback and left out.

searchDocs.title: LoadChildren​
searchDocs.content: </> OnBoot.LoadChildren( parent: Instance | {Instance }, predicate: PredicateFn? ) → LoadedModules Requires the ModuleScripts that are direct children of parent. Modules that fail to load are warned about with a traceback and left out.

searchDocs.title: LoadModule​
searchDocs.content: </> OnBoot.LoadModule(module: Instance | {Instance }) → LoadedModules Requires one ModuleScript, or an array of them. Errors if any entry is not a ModuleScript.

searchDocs.title: SpawnAll​
searchDocs.content: </> OnBoot.SpawnAll( modules: LoadedModules, methodName: string?,-- Method to call on table modules; omit to call function modules instead callback: (() → ())?-- Called once every method has finished ) → () Calls methodName on every module, each in its own thread via task.spawn. Modules start in descending Priority, then by name. Errors are warned about with a traceback and still count as finished.

searchDocs.title: DeferAll​
searchDocs.content: </> OnBoot.DeferAll( modules: LoadedModules, methodName: string?,-- Method to call on table modules; omit to call function modules instead callback: (() → ())?-- Called once every method has finished ) → () Same as OnBoot.SpawnAll, but starts each method with task.defer.

searchDocs.title: SpawnPhases​
searchDocs.content: </> OnBoot.SpawnPhases( modules: LoadedModules, phases: {string},-- Method names to run in order, e.g. { "Init", "Start" } onComplete: (() → ())?-- Called once the last phase has finished ) → () Runs each phase with OnBoot.SpawnAll. A phase starts only after every method in the previous phase has finished.

searchDocs.title: DeferPhases​
searchDocs.content: </> OnBoot.DeferPhases( modules: LoadedModules, phases: {string},-- Method names to run in order, e.g. { "Init", "Start" } onComplete: (() → ())?-- Called once the last phase has finished ) → () Same as OnBoot.SpawnPhases, but starts each method with task.defer.

searchDocs.title: SpawnAllAsync​
searchDocs.content: This is a yielding function. When called, it will pause the Lua thread that called the function until a result is ready to be returned, without interrupting other scripts. Yields </> OnBoot.SpawnAllAsync( modules: LoadedModules, methodName: string?,-- Method to call on table modules; omit to call function modules instead callback: (() → ())?-- Called once every method has finished, before this returns ) → () Same as OnBoot.SpawnAll, but yields until every method has finished.

searchDocs.title: FindName​
searchDocs.content: </> OnBoot.FindName(name: string) → PredicateFn Matches modules whose name contains name (plain text, no patterns).

searchDocs.title: FindParentName​
searchDocs.content: </> OnBoot.FindParentName(parentName: string) → PredicateFn Matches modules whose parent's name contains parentName (plain text, no patterns).

searchDocs.title: MatchName​
searchDocs.content: </> OnBoot.MatchName( name: string-- A Luau string pattern ) → PredicateFn Matches modules whose name matches the pattern name.

searchDocs.title: MatchParentName​
searchDocs.content: </> OnBoot.MatchParentName( parentName: string-- A Luau string pattern ) → PredicateFn Matches modules whose parent's name matches the pattern parentName.

searchDocs.title: SetVerbose​
searchDocs.content: </> OnBoot.SetVerbose(state: boolean) → () Logs every call, every completed phase, and every phase field that is not a function.

searchDocs.title: SetWarnTimeout​
searchDocs.content: </> OnBoot.SetWarnTimeout( seconds: number-- 0 disables the warning ) → () Sets how long to wait before warning about methods that are still running. Defaults to 5.
